title: readonly-guard residual: braced-variable assignment-fronted nested shell (M0-T109 G5 MEDIUM)
objective: Close the pre-existing MEDIUM residual found by the M0-T109 G5 security review: braced-variable assignment (dollar-brace x = powershell -enc <b64>, dollar-brace a-b = ...) launders an assignment-fronted nested shell past _launches_nested_shell because _SEGMENT_CHARS includes brace chars, so _split_command_segments tears the braced form before _effective_command_token runs. Fix: normalize braced var names to bare before segment-splitting OR extend _effective_command_token/_ASSIGN_LAYER to the brace form; add RED-on-mutant + no-FP rows; update the guard docstring to stop implying the brace form is covered until fixed. Pre-existing since M0-T108 (not introduced by M0-T109); bounded by the orchestrator-only compensating control. Keep Bash pack byte-unchanged; preserve all existing denials.
business_reason: Independent G5 finding on the accepted guard; tracked as a bounded follow-up per post-review discovery discipline (not a reopening of M0-T108/M0-T109).
